_comment: Environment catalog: the operator-specific data the advisory hooks act on (MCP server names, topic routes, failure-pattern files, repo paths, labels). Hook LOGIC is generic; this file is where an environment is described. Every list here ships EMPTY, so each consuming hook is a clean no-op until a section is filled in. Do not edit this file in the repo: install.sh copies it to ~/.claude/environment-catalog.json once (never overwriting), and that copy is yours to fill; CLAUDE_ENVIRONMENT_CATALOG=<path> overrides both. Layers merge SECTION BY SECTION (a layer that defines a section replaces it wholesale). Keys starting with '_' are comments. See contracts/environment-catalog.example.json for every section in use and hooks/_environment_catalog.py for the loader.

security_write_confirm._comment: hooks/security-write-confirm.py. servers: 'mcp__<server>__' -> {label, write_indicators[]} for stable-named servers. operation_rules: servers whose id changes per install, matched by operation name instead ({label, op_prefix | op_names[], write_indicators[] | write_indicators_from[]}). wrapper_tools: generic envelopes whose real operation rides in the arguments ({label, write_indicators[] | write_indicators_from[], inner_op_keys[] optional}).

topic_routes._comment: by_tool_prefix: hooks/auto-topic-loader.py injects agent-memory/topics/<file> on the first call to a matching 'mcp__<server>__' prefix. by_keyword: hooks/subagent-stop.py routes captured worker learnings to a topic by the first matching keyword (order matters; list compound keywords before the generic ones they contain).

failure_patterns._comment: hooks/post-failure-guide.py. servers: MCP server token (hyphens/underscores removed, matched as a substring of the server name) -> <name>-patterns.md under the project memory dir. hints: error keyword -> fix text, checked before the hook's built-in generic hints.

agent_dispatch._comment: hooks/pre-agent-dispatch.py. auth_mcp_keywords: words naming authenticated remote MCPs that subagents cannot reach (matched as whole words, case-insensitive). protected_repo_paths: lowercase path fragments of repos whose subagent writes require isolation: "worktree".

session_start._comment: hooks/session-start.py checks config_repo's branch and dirty state and warns another session may have left it mid-work. null disables the check.

env_exports._comment: hooks/session_start_modules/env_loader.py writes these to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE at session start. values: NAME -> value (`~` and `$VAR` in a value expand at write time). secrets: variable NAMES resolved at write time from an already-set variable, then the macOS Keychain (bin/keychain-seed); no secret value ever belongs in a catalog.
